note: No presentation. This is the member that carries the room-issued `read` grant, so a payload without it is a request to enumerate a room's key chain with no authority at all — the one omission that must never validate.

fromEpoch below the minimum. Epoch 1 is a room's first and has no predecessor, so there is no rung 1 to return; a request for one is asking for a link that wraps something which is not an earlier epoch's key.

limit of zero. A request that can only ever return nothing is a request whose author meant something else; the floor of 1 makes it say so rather than silently succeeding with an empty chain that reads like a severed history.

Unknown top-level payload member — additionalProperties: false catches `sinceEpoch`. Worth a fixture because it is the plausible wrong guess: the sibling rooms/records/list pages forward with `sinceVersion`, and this task walks backwards with `fromEpoch`.
